items.question: Complète : What ___ you doing at 9 o'clock last night?
items.explanation: Past continuous : was/were + verbe en -ing. Avec you, on utilise were.

items.question: Complète : The lights went out while Chloé ___ a shower.
items.explanation: Past continuous : was/were + verbe en -ing. Chloé = she, donc was taking.

items.question: Quelle phrase est correcte ?
items.explanation: Know est un verbe d'état : jamais de forme en -ing. On utilise le past simple, knew.

items.question: Complète : I was reading when my phone suddenly ___.
items.explanation: L'action courte qui interrompt le décor est au past simple. Ring est irrégulier : rang.

items.question: Complète : ___ you sleeping when I called you?
items.explanation: Question au past continuous : was/were se place avant le sujet. Avec you, c'est were.

items.question: Quelle phrase décrit deux actions longues qui se déroulent en même temps ?
options: While I was studying, my brother was playing video games.
I was studying when my brother came home.
I studied and then I played video games.
items.explanation: Deux actions longues et simultanées : past continuous des deux côtés, souvent reliées par while.

items.prompt: My parents ___ having breakfast when I woke up.
items.explanation: Past continuous : was/were + verbe en -ing. My parents = they, donc were.

items.prompt: Sorry, I didn't hear you. I ___ (listen) to music.
items.explanation: On décrit ce qui était en train de se passer à ce moment-là : past continuous, was + verbe en -ing.

items.prompt: ___ it raining when you left school?
items.explanation: Question au past continuous : was/were se place avant le sujet. Avec it, c'est was.

items.prompt: We ___ (swim) in the sea when we saw a dolphin.
items.explanation: On était en train de nager quand l'événement soudain est arrivé : past continuous. Attention, swim double le m : swimming.

answers: I wasn't sleeping when you called me.
When you called me I wasn't sleeping.
items.translation: Je ne dormais pas quand tu m'as appelé.
items.explanation: Négation au past continuous : wasn't + verbe en -ing. L'appel, action courte, est au past simple.

answers: My brother was cleaning his room while I was cooking.
While I was cooking my brother was cleaning his room.
items.translation: Mon frère rangeait sa chambre pendant que je cuisinais.
items.explanation: Deux actions longues en même temps : past continuous dans les deux parties, reliées par while.

answers: Were your parents working yesterday afternoon?
items.translation: Est-ce que tes parents travaillaient hier après-midi ?
items.explanation: Question au past continuous : were avant le sujet (your parents = they), puis le verbe en -ing.
